monster.name: Modron Cluster

hp.special: 300 (Chaos Threshold). See the Chaos Threshold & Vulnerable Areas trait below for additional, separate HP pools.

immune.special: psychic (only while its Consortium Seals are intact; see below)

trait.name: Kaiju Fortitude
entries: The Modron Cluster is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form or move it to another plane of existence against its will.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, +3 Additional While in Rampage)
entries: If the Modron Cluster fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

bonus.name: Shake Off
entries: Each creature mounted on the Modron Cluster must succeed on a DC 22 Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice) or be thrown off, landing prone in the nearest unoccupied space.

reaction.name: Nullification Field (Requires Intact Ocular Complex)
entries: When a creature within 120 feet casts a spell, the Modron Cluster can unleash an antimagic pulse. The spell fails and has no effect, functioning as a 9th-level {@spell counterspell}.

entries: The Modron Cluster makes one Exorcism Slam attack.

entries: (1/Round.) The Modron Cluster fires its {@i Ray of Erasure} at a single target. This legendary action recharges at the start of the Modron Cluster's turn. (Lost if the Ocular Complex is destroyed.)
